name: jev-native
description: Traceable first-pass review of public code and documents with TypeSafe Jev.

interface.shortDescription: Traceable Jev review queues for public collections.
interface.longDescription: Ranks and screens bounded public or synthetic collections, links results to stable source IDs, checks claims against exact passages, and records spend and reviewed outcomes through a loopback or private-network MCP endpoint backed by hosted TypeSafe Jev. Results remain advisory.
defaultPrompt: Audit this public source queue without dropping anything.
Compare this public claim with its exact evidence span.
Extract atomic signals from this larger synthetic queue.
